parameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit Image1 into ONE independently drawn 1254x1254 transparent RGBA game sprite. Image1 is the edit target and exact composition; Image2 is same-direction leg/stance continuity only, never copy its pose; Image3 is identity/hand ownership; Image4 is the approved bright rounded clean Daoist chibi hand-painted finish. Preserve Image1 head position and size, face, hair, ribbons, torso, sleeves, qin and hands. LEFT hand supports upper qin, RIGHT hand lower strings; no hand swap. Redraw ONLY lower trousers, hips-to-knees as needed, calves, ankles and boots to show the stated weight-bearing position. RIGHT leg is screen LEFT, LEFT leg screen RIGHT. Both boots' long axes point straight toward the camera/downscreen, parallel, never splay sideways. A planted boot shows its upper/front and a thin horizontal sole rim, not a large bottom face. Rearward position is deeper in the scene/slightly higher in screen relative to pelvis, NOT sideways. Keep native source root[627,1215], upper-body coordinates and natural perspective. TARGET S10 is second LEFT forward acceptance pose. The low anatomical LEFT boot on SCREEN RIGHT accepts weight at its current forward location: forefoot pressed down, ankle under bent knee, small natural absorption. This follows initial contact with slightly more loaded knee, not another hovering kick.
